tool_schemas.name: todoist_create_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new task under the specified connected Todoist account and returns the created task record with mirrored fields (including its internal task ULID). If an idempotency_key is provided, повторные calls with the same key return the previously created task instead of creating a duplicate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including ULID patterns, priority range, or invalid due_at format), NOT_FOUND if account_id (or project_id when provided) does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authorized/connected, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: ULID of the connected Todoist account to act as.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided key used to deduplicate repeated create requests.

project_id.description: Internal project ULID to create the task under.

due_date.description: Due date as a date string (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD).

due_at.description: Due datetime as an RFC3339 timestamp.

labels.description: List of label names to apply to the task.

assignee_todoist_user_id.description: Todoist user id of the assignee (for shared projects).

order_index.description: Optional ordering index to position the task.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_get_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of tasks for the given connected account, filtered by status/project/content_query/labels/assignee and optionally bounded by due_before/due_after, sorted by the requested field and direction. Results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor; when more results exist, the response includes a next cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters (including enum values, limit bounds, ULID patterns, or invalid RFC3339 timestamps), NOT_FOUND if account_id (or project_id when provided) does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authorized/connected, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: ULID of the connected Todoist account to query.

project_id.description: Filter tasks to a specific internal project ULID.

labels.description: Filter to tasks that have these label names.

assignee_todoist_user_id.description: Filter tasks assigned to the given Todoist user id.

due_before.description: Filter to tasks with due_at earlier than this RFC3339 timestamp.

due_after.description: Filter to tasks with due_at later than this RFC3339 timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_update_task
tool_schemas.description: Updates a single task for the specified connected account and returns the updated task record; the task is identified by task_id when provided, otherwise by searching for an active task matching search_name. If an idempotency_key is provided, repeated calls with the same key return the previous update result without applying the update twice. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if identifiers/fields are invalid or if neither task_id nor search_name is provided, NOT_FOUND if account_id does not exist or if no task can be resolved from task_id/search_name, CONFLICT if search_name matches multiple tasks or if the requested update is not allowed for the task’s current status, UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authorized/connected, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: ULID of the connected Todoist account to act as.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided key used to deduplicate repeated update requests.

search_name.description: Task name/content to search for to identify the task to update.

task_id.description: Internal task ULID to update (bypasses search_name if provided).

project_id.description: Move task to this internal project ULID.

due_date.description: New due date as a date string (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD).

due_at.description: New due datetime as an RFC3339 timestamp.

labels.description: Replacement list of label names for the task.

order_index.description: New ordering index to position the task.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_delete_task
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a single task for the specified connected account and returns a confirmation of deletion; the task is identified by task_id when provided, otherwise by searching for an active task matching search_name. If an idempotency_key is provided, repeated calls with the same key return the previous delete result without deleting again. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither task_id nor search_name is provided or if identifiers are malformed, NOT_FOUND if account_id does not exist or if no task can be resolved from task_id/search_name, CONFLICT if search_name matches multiple tasks or if the task is already deleted, UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authorized/connected, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: ULID of the connected Todoist account to act as.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided key used to deduplicate repeated delete requests.

search_name.description: Task name/content to search for to identify the task to delete.

task_id.description: Internal task ULID to delete (bypasses search_name if provided).

tool_schemas.name: todoist_complete_task
tool_schemas.description: Marks a single task as completed for the specified connected account and returns the updated task record; the task is identified by task_id when provided, otherwise by searching for an active task matching search_name. If an idempotency_key is provided, repeated calls with the same key return the previous completion result without completing again. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither task_id nor search_name is provided or if identifiers are malformed, NOT_FOUND if account_id does not exist or if no task can be resolved from task_id/search_name, CONFLICT if search_name matches multiple tasks or if the task is already completed/deleted, UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authorized/connected, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: ULID of the connected Todoist account to act as.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided key used to deduplicate repeated complete requests.

search_name.description: Task name/content to search for to identify the task to complete.

task_id.description: Internal task ULID to complete (bypasses search_name if provided).

tool_schemas.name: todoist_get_task
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single mirrored task record by internal task ULID for the specified connected account. Refuses access if the task does not belong to the account, or if the account is not active. May refresh from Todoist if the task is stale according to server sync policy; if Todoist auth fails, the call fails and the account may be transitioned to status='error'.

account_id.description: ULID of the connected Todoist account to query.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_get_projects
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of mirrored projects for the given connected account, optionally filtered by status/name_query/is_inbox/is_archived and sorted by the requested field and direction. Results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor; when more results exist, the response includes a next cursor to fetch the next page. Refuses invalid filters and refuses access if the account is not active.

account_id.description: ULID of the connected Todoist account to query.

is_inbox.description: When true/false, filters to only inbox/non-inbox projects.

is_archived.description: When true/false, filters to only archived/non-archived projects.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_get_accounts
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of connected Todoist accounts visible to the caller, optionally filtered by provider/status/todoist_user_id. This is used to discover which account_id values can be used with task/project tools. Refuses invalid filters; does not return access_token_ciphertext, and only returns token_last4 for display/auditing purposes.

todoist_user_id.description: Filter accounts by Todoist user id.

limit.description: Maximum number of accounts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and its effective entitlements for this MCP server, including granted scopes and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses requests with missing/invalid credentials and returns a stable principal identifier suitable for audit correlation.

include_quota.description: When true, includes rate-limit and quota consumption details if available.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def todoist_whoami(include_quota=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, uuid

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0149000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0149000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    # Validate inputs
    if include_quota is not None and not isinstance(include_quota, bool):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "include_quota must be a boolean when provided.")

    accounts = _load("accounts.json")
    inv = _load("tool_invocations.json")

    # Resolve an active account that can serve the call.
    active = [a for a in accounts if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("provider") == "todoist" and a.get("status") == "active"]
    if not active:
        # No active account => UNAUTHORIZED per business rules. Also log tool invocation if possible.
        # We cannot write a tool_invocations row without an account_id that references accounts.id.
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active Todoist account is configured for this server.")

    # Deterministically pick the most recently verified, else most recently updated, else first.
    def _dt(v):
        if not v or not isinstance(v, str):
            return ""
        return v

    active_sorted = sorted(
        active,
        key=lambda a: (_dt(a.get("last_verified_at")), _dt(a.get("updated_at")), _dt(a.get("created_at")), a.get("id") or ""),
        reverse=True,
    )
    acct = active_sorted[0]
    account_id = acct.get("id")

    # Quota/rate-limits (implementation-defined; enforced/observed via tool_invocations)
    # Rate limit: 60 calls / rolling minute per account (all tools).
    # Quota: 10,000 calls / rolling 30 days per account (all tools).
    RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN = 60
    QUOTA_PER_30D = 10000

    # compute windows
    def _parse_iso(s):
        if not isinstance(s, str) or not s:
            return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                s = s[:-1]
            # accept seconds precision; ignore fractional if present
            if "." in s:
                s = s.split(".", 1)[0]
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None

    now_dt = _parse_iso(now) or datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    win_1m = now_dt - datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)
    win_30d = now_dt - datetime.timedelta(days=30)

    # Only count invocations for this account_id; treat any status as a "call" for consumption
    inv_for_acct = [r for r in inv if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("account_id") == account_id]
    used_1m = 0
    used_30d = 0
    for r in inv_for_acct:
        c = _parse_iso(r.get("created_at"))
        if not c:
            continue
        if c >= win_1m:
            used_1m += 1
        if c >= win_30d:
            used_30d += 1

    # Enforce rate limit/quota BEFORE recording this call as running/succeeded (but still must record every call).
    # Real services typically count the attempted call; we will log it as failed when blocked.
    blocked = None
    if used_1m >= RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN:
        blocked = ("RATE_LIMIT", f"Rate limit exceeded: {RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN} calls per rolling minute.")
    elif used_30d >= QUOTA_PER_30D:
        blocked = ("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", f"Quota exceeded: {QUOTA_PER_30D} calls per rolling 30 days.")

    # Create tool_invocations row (received->running->succeeded/failed).
    inv_id = "inv_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    req_payload = {}
    if include_quota is not None:
        req_payload["include_quota"] = include_quota

    inv_row = {
        "id": inv_id,
        "account_id": account_id,
        "tool_name": "todoist_whoami",
        "request_payload": req_payload,
        "resolved_search_name": None,
        "matched_task_id": None,
        "status": "received",
        "error_message": None,
        "response_payload": None,
        "idempotency_key": None,
        "duration_ms": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }

    # Transition received -> running
    inv_row["status"] = "running"
    inv_row["updated_at"] = now
    inv.append(inv_row)
    _save("tool_invocations.json", inv)

    if blocked:
        code, msg = blocked
        # Update invocation to failed
        inv = _load("tool_invocations.json")
        for r in inv:
            if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("id") == inv_id:
                r["status"] = "failed"
                r["error_message"] = msg
                r["response_payload"] = {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg}}
                r["duration_ms"] = int(round((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
                r["updated_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
                break
        _save("tool_invocations.json", inv)
        return _err(code, msg)

    # Build response
    principal_id = f"todoist_account:{account_id}"
    identity = {
        "principal_id": principal_id,
        "provider": "todoist",
        "account_id": account_id,
        "todoist_user_id": acct.get("todoist_user_id"),
        "display_name": acct.get("display_name"),
        "token_last4": acct.get("token_last4"),
        "account_status": acct.get("status"),
        "last_verified_at": acct.get("last_verified_at"),
    }

    # Entitlements are implementation-defined; this server supports the task/project mirror tools.
    entitlements = {
        "scopes": [
            "tasks:read",
            "tasks:write",
            "projects:read",
        ],
        "tools_allowed": [
            "todoist_create_task",
            "todoist_get_tasks",
            "todoist_update_task",
            "todoist_delete_task",
            "todoist_complete_task",
            "todoist_whoami",
        ],
    }

    quota = None
    if include_quota:
        remaining_1m = max(0, RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN - used_1m - 1)  # include this call
        remaining_30d = max(0, QUOTA_PER_30D - used_30d - 1)
        reset_1m = (win_1m + datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        reset_30d = (win_30d + datetime.timedelta(days=30)).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        quota = {
            "rate_limit": {
                "window": "rolling_60s",
                "limit": RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN,
                "used": used_1m + 1,
                "remaining": remaining_1m,
                "reset_at": reset_1m,
            },
            "quota": {
                "window": "rolling_30d",
                "limit": QUOTA_PER_30D,
                "used": used_30d + 1,
                "remaining": remaining_30d,
                "reset_at": reset_30d,
            },
        }

    resp = {
        "identity": identity,
        "entitlements": entitlements,
    }
    if include_quota:
        resp["quota"] = quota

    # Mark invocation succeeded
    inv = _load("tool_invocations.json")
    end_now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    for r in inv:
        if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("id") == inv_id:
            r["status"] = "succeeded"
            r["error_message"] = None
            r["response_payload"] = resp
            r["duration_ms"] = int(round((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
            r["updated_at"] = end_now
            break
    _save("tool_invocations.json", inv)

    return resp

metadata.name: Todoist MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend models a lightweight Todoist-integrated task service exposed via an MCP server. It stores connected Todoist accounts, mirrors key task fields for fast search-by-name operations, and records tool invocations for auditing and idempotency across create/update/delete/complete workflows.
